description: Shared PURE absence-summary core (issue #40). Add packages/shared/src/absence.ts: a pure, no-I/O function that compares the monster BEFORE applyTimePassage against the monster AFTER it (the applyTimePassage output) and returns a structured AbsenceSummary of what changed during the player's absence, plus a documented threshold constant and a pure recommended-action helper. Export everything from the shared barrel and unit-test with before/after pairs built via applyTimePassage. This is the single source of truth consumed by the frontend welcome-back UI in FEAT-002.
steps: Create packages/shared/src/absence.ts. Import Monster/GrowthStage/MonsterForm types and the affectionOf/formOf helpers from game.ts/types where needed. Define and EXPORT a documented constant `ABSENCE_SUMMARY_THRESHOLD_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000` (5 minutes) with a doc comment explaining it is the minimum absence (now - lastUpdatedAt at load) before the welcome-back summary is shown; it is the single source of truth so the frontend reuses it rather than hardcoding.

Define and EXPORT an `AbsenceSummary` interface with clearly-documented fields: `elapsedMs: number` (max(0, after.lastUpdatedAt - before.lastUpdatedAt)); `hungerDelta: number` (after.hungryLevel - before.hungryLevel, >=0 in practice); `becameDirty: boolean` (!before.dirty && after.dirty); `hpDelta: number` (after.stats.hp - before.stats.hp, signed); `hpLostFromStarving: number` (max(0, -hpDelta) when the monster was NOT sleeping, else 0); `hpGainedFromSleeping: number` (max(0, hpDelta) when before.isSleeping, else 0); `wasSleeping: boolean` (before.isSleeping); `evolved: boolean` (before.stageId !== after.stageId); `fromStageId`/`toStageId: GrowthStage`; `fromForm`/`toForm: MonsterForm` (via formOf so legacy saves normalize to 'base'); `affectionDelta: number` (affectionOf(after) - affectionOf(before), typically <=0 from neglect); `hasChanges: boolean` (true iff any observable change occurred: hungerDelta!==0 || becameDirty || hpDelta!==0 || evolved || affectionDelta!==0).

Implement and EXPORT `summarizeAbsence(before: Monster, after: Monster): AbsenceSummary`. Pure, no mutation, no Date.now(), no I/O. Derive every field per the semantics above. Document that `after` is expected to be the result of applyTimePassage(before, now) (so elapsedMs is derived from the lastUpdatedAt difference rather than taking a separate `now`, keeping it a pure two-arg function of the before/after snapshots). Use the shared formOf/affectionOf so legacy (undefined form/affection) saves are handled consistently.

Define and EXPORT a pure recommended-action helper `recommendedCareAction(summary: AbsenceSummary): CareRecommendation` where `export type CareRecommendation = 'feed' | 'clean' | 'wake' | 'none'`. Priority order (documented): if the monster is starving/very hungry (hungerDelta pushed hunger up AND hunger is the dominant need) recommend 'feed'; here, because the summary does not carry the absolute post-hunger level, ALSO export a convenience overload/variant `recommendCareFromMonster(after: Monster): CareRecommendation` that reads the absolute state of the post-advance monster (feed when hungryLevel >= HUNGRY_CAUTION_LEVEL, else clean when dirty, else wake when isSleeping, else none) so the one-tap button maps to a concrete care action. Prefer implementing recommendedCareAction in terms of recommendCareFromMonster if cleaner; the frontend will call the monster-based variant. Document the priority order and that 'none' means no single clearly-useful action.
Add `export * from "./absence.ts";` to packages/shared/src/index.ts (after the existing exports).

Create packages/shared/src/__tests__/absence.test.ts following the game.test.ts pattern (node:test `test`, `assert/strict`, a fixed T0 epoch, createMonster for fixtures). Build before/after pairs by calling applyTimePassage over various gaps/states and assert the AbsenceSummary fields. Cover at minimum: (a) no-change (0ms gap / sub-tick gap -> hasChanges false, all deltas 0, evolved false); (b) hunger-only (a few ticks awake, not yet dirty/starving -> hungerDelta>0, becameDirty false, hpDelta 0); (c) became dirty (>=3 ticks awake -> becameDirty true); (d) starving HP loss (hunger driven to MAX then more ticks -> hpDelta<0, hpLostFromStarving>0, hpGainedFromSleeping 0); (e) sleeping HP gain (monster asleep with reduced hp over several ticks -> hpDelta>0, hpGainedFromSleeping>0, wasSleeping true, hungerDelta 0); (f) evolution (trainingCount+age sufficient so applyTimePassage evolves baby->rookie -> evolved true, fromStageId 'baby', toStageId 'rookie', toForm set); (g) combined (hunger up + became dirty + affection decayed in one gap). Also test recommendCareFromMonster: feed when hungry, clean when dirty (not hungry), wake when sleeping (not hungry/dirty), none when healthy; and that ABSENCE_SUMMARY_THRESHOLD_MS equals 300000.
Run the shared build + tests to confirm green.
acceptance_criteria: packages/shared/src/absence.ts exports ABSENCE_SUMMARY_THRESHOLD_MS (=300000), AbsenceSummary, summarizeAbsence, recommendCareFromMonster (and/or recommendedCareAction), CareRecommendation.
summarizeAbsence is pure (no Date.now, no I/O, does not mutate inputs) and derives elapsedMs from the before/after lastUpdatedAt difference.

New shared test file absence.test.ts covers no-change, hunger-only, became-dirty, starving HP loss, sleeping HP gain, evolution, and combined cases, plus the recommended-action helper and the threshold value.
npm run build passes; npm test (shared) passes with pass count > 126 and 0 fail.
verification: npm test  (shared; confirm pass count increased above 126 and 0 fail, absence.test.ts cases all pass)
findings: Added packages/shared/src/absence.ts with ABSENCE_SUMMARY_THRESHOLD_MS (=300000), AbsenceSummary interface, pure summarizeAbsence(before, after), CareRecommendation type, recommendCareFromMonster (absolute-state, used by FE one-tap button) and recommendedCareAction (summary-delta variant). Barrel export added to index.ts. New absence.test.ts adds 15 cases (no-change, sub-tick, hunger-only, became-dirty, starving HP loss, sleeping HP gain, evolution baby->rookie, combined, non-mutation, and all 4 recommendCareFromMonster branches + threshold). npm run build passes; npm test shared pass count 140 (0 fail), up from baseline 126. No frontend touched (FEAT-002 consumes these exports).
